fixed.how: A sessionEnds(sessionId, why) helper waits on the session's end through the client with a 30 s bound and a message naming what it saw; the case before waits for its own session to end; the note case asserts started.result === 'started' before reading the session. Nothing the case checks was weakened.

notes_for_other_areas: CommandPorts.limitChanged(projectId|null) -> Promise<string|null> (packages/commands): budget.set calls it after a month or project write; compose wires it to RuntimeApp.wakeLimitWaits (wakeBudgetWaitsDetailed) and returns wokenLine; GET /projects/:id/start-check and POST /sessions call rt.wakeLimitWaits() first.
AdmitOutcome gains 'too_large' (session/live-sessions.ts; runner admit when the estimate exceeds the session's work budget); preparedLine('too_large') and START_OFFER_OUTCOMES include it.
RequestWords.submit / HumanRequestView.submit {label, explain} for questions cards; afterDoneWords in request-words.ts for Answered lines once the task is done.

MessageView.action {kind:'continue', label, explain, projectId, sessionId, budgetLeft} on GET /inbox messages (crashContinueOf in daemon/views.ts); INTERRUPTED_UPDATE_LEAD in session/recovery-words.ts (a leaf the UI's fake daemon imports).
started-by-words.ts: startedByReason / startedLine / startedByOfValue, the one map of who started a session (Sessions row and the session page's first line).

ProjectStatusInput.workingWhat and ProjectCardFacts.workingWhat (the run indicator entry's `what`); status line action gains optional `explain`; ProjectCard.startsAfter (the project a queued start waits behind); QUEUED_CANCEL_EXPLAIN in project-status.ts.

POST /projects/:id/continuation/cancel also drops a person's start waiting in line behind another project's session; a second POST /sessions for such a project answers the same start with result 'queued' and a sentence.
listEndWords / stillWaitsText for the Sessions row's end words; the session page badge keeps endedStatusText.

Fake daemon: workingWhat, runReview (session id -> title the critic checks), POST /__test/waiting {projectId, head, view}, startsAfter, and reset now clears runningExtra, runCredential, runReview, startsWait.
Session listedWhere (state) also lists plan.startedBy.by in (person, continuation) and handoff.stop_reason = credential_wait, both dialects (ADR 0116 amendment 2026-11-23).
